title: Clean setting for quotation cards
statement: Set a quotation card in a film without a one-word last line, and start a marked word's underline on the word, not on the space before it.
detail: Both faults are recorded in the notes on a lesson's video essay, which draws its quotation cards from shared film modules: the card left one word alone on its last line, and the underline under a marked word began on the space before it. They were listed as work for those modules and are not fixed in this repo.

evidence.quote: the quote card leaves a one-word last line, and its underline starts on the space before a marked word.
